items.source: Constructs a new MarshallingView with the given Marshaller set.
items.translation: 构造一个新的带有给定Marshaller 集的MarshallingView。

items.source: Set the Marshaller to be used by this view.
items.translation: 设置此视图使用的Marshaller。

items.source: The Object to be marshalled is supplied as a parameter in the model and then detected during response rendering. Users can either specify a specific entry in the model via the sourceKey property or have Spring locate the Source object.
items.translation: 要序列化的对象作为参数在模型中提供，然后在响应渲染期间检测。用户可以通过模型的 sourceKey 属性指定特定条目，或者让 Spring 定位 Source 对象。

items.source: The default implementation calls Marshaller.supports(Class), unwrapping a given JAXBElement first if applicable.
items.translation: 默认实现会调用Marshaller.supports(Class)，如果适用，则首先解包给定的JAXBElement。

items.source: The default implementation is empty. Called by ApplicationObjectSupport.initApplicationContext(ApplicationContext).
items.translation: 默认实现为空。由 ApplicationObjectSupport.initApplicationContext(ApplicationContext) 调用。

items.source: The default implementation first attempts to look under the configured model key, if any, before attempting to locate an object of supported type.
items.translation: 默认实现首先尝试在配置的模型键（如果有）下查找，然后再尝试定位一个支持类型的对象。

items.source: Construct a new MarshallingView with no Marshaller set. The marshaller must be set after construction by invoking setMarshaller(Marshaller).
items.translation: 构建一个新的不带Marshaller的MarshallingView。必须在构造后通过调用setMarshaller(Marshaller)来设置 marshaller。

items.source: Construct a new MarshallingView with no Marshaller set.
items.translation: 构建一个新的不带Marshaller的MarshallingView。

items.source: Description copied from class: ApplicationObjectSupport
items.translation: 描述从类复制：ApplicationObjectSupport

items.source: Check whether the given value from the current view's model is eligible for marshalling through the configured Marshaller.
items.translation: 检查当前视图模型中给定的值是否可以通过配置的Marshaller进行编组。

items.source:
Set the name of the model key that represents the object to be marshalled.
If not specified, the model map will be searched for a supported value type.
items.translation: 设置表示要反序列化的对象的模型键名称。如果未指定，则将在模型映射中搜索支持的值类型。

items.source: initApplicationContext in class ApplicationObjectSupport
items.translation: `initApplicationContext` 类中的 `ApplicationObjectSupport`

items.source: IllegalStateException - if the model object specified by the model key is not supported by the marshaller
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果由 模型键 指定的模型对象不受 marshaller 支持

items.source: modelKey - the value's key in the model (never null)
items.translation: modelKey - 模型中值的键（永远不为 null）

items.source: value - the value to check (never null)
items.translation: value - 要检查的值（永远不为 null）

items.source: the Object to be marshalled (or null if none found)
items.translation: 要反序列化的对象（如果未找到则为null）

items.source: whether the given value is to be considered as eligible
items.translation: 给定值是否被视为合格

items.source:
The first step will be preparing the request: In the JSP case,
this would mean setting model objects as request attributes.
The second step will be the actual rendering of the view,
for example including the JSP via a RequestDispatcher.
items.translation: 第一步是准备请求：在 JSP 的情况下，这意味着将模型对象设置为请求属性。第二步是视图的实际渲染，例如通过 RequestDispatcher 包含 JSP。

items.translation: 子类可以重写此方法以实现自定义初始化行为。

items.translation: 定位要反序列化的对象。

items.translation: 设置表示要反序列化的对象的模型键名称。

items.translation: 默认内容类型。可作为 Bean 属性进行覆盖。
